newsitem.title: USA: Maine Republicans say budget gap is overblown.
newsitem.headline: Maine Republicans say budget gap is overblown.

text.p: Maine Republican Senate President Jeff Butland said Gov. Angus King's projected budget shortfall is a figment of his imagination.
Butland also said the idea that tax cuts pushed by Republicans led to the crisis is ridiculous, explaining the problem continues to be spending, not revenue.
But the governor disagrees, saying one of the taxes to be put back on the table is an income tax cap supported by Republicans.
The Maine legislature in mid-October estimated that the state will face a $363 million gap in the next two-year budget, about $60 million less than King's staff had projected.
